product: GEDI L4B Gridded Aboveground Biomass Density v2.1 (1 km): MU and SE layers
attribution: Dubayah, R.O., J. Armston, S.P. Healey, Z. Yang, P.L. Patterson, S. Saarela, G. Stahl, L. Duncanson, J.R. Kellner, J. Bruening, and A. Pascual. 2023. GEDI L4B Gridded Aboveground Biomass Density, Version 2.1. ORNL DAAC, Oak Ridge, Tennessee, USA. https://doi.org/10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2299
method: Mean of valid pixels whose centres fall in each res-6 cell inside the region box. GEDI L4B v2.1 1 km gridded aboveground biomass density (MU) and its standard error (SE), pixel centres projected from EPSG:6933. agbd_se is the mean of the pixel standard errors, not the error of the cell mean. GEDI samples only up to ~51.6°N.
sampling: mean of pixel centres in cell
